ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with a dominant high-intensity white/cream central region (~80%) and a low-intensity black perimeter (~20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central lobes; dark black pigmentation along the trailing and lateral edges; scattered dark circular spots on the right lobe; localized tan/brownish mottling on the lower-left and lower-right quadrants near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; approximate angle of 65 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; visible jagged peaks on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; smoother topography near the center of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on both lobes, tapering to distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Circular dark spots clustered on the right lobe; high-contrast white circular scars visible on the black margin of the upper-right trailing edge; barnacle clusters at the extreme distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct horizontal dark linear mark on the lower-left lobe; series of fine diagonal rake marks traversing the white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization on both distal tips; multiple circular scars and pitting on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive tan/yellowish discoloration/staining across the inner-lower portions of both fluke lobes.
